verdict.rationale: vLLM ships an official, documented CLI with its own reference section. It covers starting the OpenAI-compatible server (`vllm serve` with documented flags), an interactive mode that prints TTFT/throughput statistics, and benchmark commands for latency and throughput. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and evidence of agent-oriented CLI ergonomics such as machine-readable output modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
Print TTFT and throughput statistics after each response
Run benchmark tests for latency online serving throughput and offline inference throughput.
The vllm serve CLI reference documents the flag pair --disable-fastapi-docs / --enable-fastapi-docs
